decisions.reason: The inbound SMS API extends the firm's existing messaging and API expertise, and its own R&D lets it learn from early results and refine the product, which has stayed on its own page across both years.
The email-to-SMS gateway combines the firm's core email and messaging channels, so the related knowledge it already holds lets it assimilate market feedback and improve the offer.
The SMS-to-email gateway complements Product B and builds on the firm's established email and integration expertise, so with its in-house R&D it is well placed to develop it further.
